why: Zephaniah 2:5 and 2:8 mean the land and nation of Canaan (here the Philistine coast) and of Moab, not the individuals Canaan and Moab.
In 2:5 'Canaan' is a name for the land of the Philistines on the coast, so a dot in the middle of the land west of the Jordan would mislead; the Philistia dot marks this verse.
Zephaniah names the Ammonites (2:8-9), the land of the Philistines (2:5) and the Cushites (2:12); Bible Atlas does not link them in this chapter.
